description: T-2939: accepted controls for the typed one-argument IF probe. Excel for the web refuses typing =IF(x) with one argument (400 InvalidArgument for =IF(TRUE), =IF(FALSE), =IF(1), =IF(0), =IF({1,0}), =IF(A1:B1), =IF("x"), =IF(NA()), =ISLOGICAL(IF(TRUE)) and =IF(TRUE)+1, each typed alone; refused entries cannot be committed), while IF with an empty or given second argument is accepted (E1:E3, FORMULATEXT in F, ISFORMULA in G).
